title: Chelsea: the Touchline Take on the injury news
body:
BBC Sport has an injury update involving Chelsea [S1]. The headline said it plainly: “Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use” [S1]. The names in the frame: Joao Pedro [S1].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Chelsea have 3 wins, 0 draws and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 9 points, 9 scored and 4 conceded [ST1].

This is where squad depth gets tested, and that is where seasons are quietly decided. This is exactly the kind of blow that exposes a thin bench. The Touchline Take: how the squad copes will define the next month.

evidence.text: BBC Sport: Chelsea staff warned over Fantasy Premier League use. Chelsea warn staff to be careful about revealing team news through Fantasy Premier League after Joao Pedro's injury appeared to have been inadvertently disclosed through team selections.
Chelsea last 5 league matches in Football-Data.co.uk results: 3 wins, 0 draws, 2 defeats, 9 points, 9 goals scored, 4 conceded (sequence WWLWL).
